passages: The partition function keeps a boundary index i for the region of elements smaller than or equal to the pivot. The index i starts at low - 1, one position before the low boundary.
A second index j scans the range from low to high - 1. When arr[j] <= pivot, i is incremented and arr[i] and arr[j] are swapped.
After the loop, the pivot is swapped into position i + 1. Every element to its left is less than or equal to the pivot.

answers.text: The index i starts at low - 1. As j scans the range, whenever arr[j] <= pivot, i goes up by one and arr[i] and arr[j] swap places.
The index i starts at low - 1, one position before the start of the range.
